_note: Per-dataset SPEC-CARD fields. These cards describe THE ATLAS, not the slice we happen to work on: `cells`, `schema` tier counts and `timepoints` are all full-published-object numbers, with `workingSlice` naming our subset where one exists. Joined on `id` to dataset_facts.json (still the source of truth for METHOD/platform and the cluster counts in the summary strip); dataset_facts.json is never modified. Values are read live from the backing .h5ad / author metadata, transcribed from repo prose, or supplied by Steven — see `_provenance`. Anything unsourced is the literal string "TBD". Where a field is not a gap but a genuine absence, it says so in words ("Unannotated — labelling target", "N/A") rather than TBD.

_provenance.cells_and_slices: Full-object n_obs read in backed mode. zscape 3,231,733 (obs[timepoint]==48 -> 813,782, matches facts.cells). daniocell 336,603 (36-72 hpf window -> 191,832, matches facts.cells). chemfish 2,068,668 (timepoint==48 -> 1,579,675, which is what facts.fullCells records; facts.cells 250,000 is our uniform sample of that). commit_gold 209,639 is the benchmark definition itself, not a subsample, so no working-slice line. megafin/megafin_parse/minifin are used whole.
_provenance.timepoints: Read from obs, never inferred. zscape obs[timepoint] = 18 values (18-48 in 2h steps, +72, +96). commit_gold obs[timepoint] = single value 48. daniocell obs[hpf] = 39 values (18-96). chemfish cell_metadata timepoint = 36/48/72. megafin/megafin_parse/minifin have NO timepoint column — single-collection designs, so they keep EXPOSURE -> COLLECTION rows.
_provenance.schema: Native label hierarchies, exact column names, counted on the full objects. zscape obs[tissue]/obs[cell_type_broad]/obs[cell_type_sub]. chemfish cell_metadata tissue/cell_type. daniocell obs[tissue.name]/obs[tissue.figure]/obs[clust]. Counts are NOT comparable across datasets — the tiers are different granularities, which is why the cards show the hierarchy rather than a normalised number.
_provenance.genes: n_vars. zscape + commit_gold + chemfish 32,031; daniocell 30,121; megafin_parse + minifin 32,520; megafin (Lawson) 36,351.
_provenance.zscape_perturbations: obs[gene_target] = 34: 28 knockouts + 6 ctrl-* arms. Matches the published spec card exactly.
_provenance.chemfish_perturbations: cell_metadata obs[perturbation] = 11 (8 compounds + DMSO/EtOH/novehicle), obs[target] = 8 (7 pathways + Control). Confirms the published spec card exactly.
_provenance.megafin_perturbations: Decoded from obs[sample] (Manual) / obs[samples] (Parse) — identical 93-well sets, format m1_<well>_CP01_<compound>_<dose>. 46 compounds = 45 small molecules + Sorafenib positive control, matching designFacts. The 3 QC-removed wells (Vorinostat 1uM/B11, Romidepsin 5uM/C3, Dinaciclib 5uM/E3) dropped ONE DOSE each, not the compound — all 46 survive in the object, so all 46 are listed and the dropped wells are noted in the summary line.
_provenance.minifin_perturbations: obs[perturbation] = 4 (DMSO, Dapagliflozin, Orlistat, Sorafenib) across obs[sample] = 43 replicate samples (DMSO 11, Dapagliflozin 10, Orlistat 11, Sorafenib 11). Spelling taken from obs[perturbation]; obs[sample] misspells it 'Dapaglifozan'.
_provenance.footers: MegaFIN + MiniFin pathway/target footers deferred to Steven — they need a target annotation he supplies.
